left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Male  [AND] participants who are healthy as determined by medical evaluation including a detailed medical history, full physical examination, including blood pressure (BP) [AND]  and pulse rate (PR) measurement, 12 lead ECG, and clinical laboratory tests
5 kg/m2; and a total body weight >50 kg (110 lb)

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Known immunodeficiency disorder, including positive serology for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) at screening, [OR]  or a first degree relative with a hereditary immunodeficiency

left.raw_text: -  Infection with hepatitis B  [OR] or hepatitis C viruses

right.raw_text: -  Participants with selected acute or chronic infections  [OR] or infection history

left.raw_text: -  Participants have a known present  [OR] or a history of malignancy other than a successfully treated  [OR] or excised non metastatic basal cell  [OR] or squamous cell cancer of the skin
-  History of alcohol abuse  [OR] or binge drinking  [OR] and/or any other illicit drug use  [OR] or dependence within 6 months of Screening

right.raw_text: -  Use of tobacco/ [OR] nicotine containing products within 3 months prior to dosing or positive urine cotinine test
